content.content: zzzzzzzz resolves to the root and names no file. It is representable where prerequisites may be roots and unrepresentable where they may not.
content.rationale: Sibling resolution is the parent's claim; the single exception is a separate commitment — one non-file target is what keeps roots expressible in depends_on without leaking files into root handling. Which edge kinds admit it stays with the contract level, where types can carry it.
